description:
We are a friendly artist run gallery in Wells Street offering affordable, handmade fine art prints with a broad range of subjects created using many different printmaking techniques.
We aim to encourage people who have never encountered art before to experience printmaking through our regular workshops.

factsheet.heading: Free Drop in Taster Printing
paragraphs: We are a friendly artist run gallery in Wells Street offering affordable, handmade fine art prints with a broad range of subjects created using many different printmaking techniques.
We aim to encourage people who have never encountered art before to experience printmaking through our regular workshops.

We will run some short printmaking workshops during the week:
Tuesday 15 September 4 - 6 pm, and Thursday 17 September 4-6 pm and Saturday  19 September 2-4 pm
All materials will be provided and you will take away your own piece of art at the end.
Workshops available from dry point, mezzotint, sgraffito, mono, chine Collé to litho printing on different days.
The gallery itself is open 11 to 6 pm every day with a printmaker on hand.
